tenant_id.description: Meguri tenant identifier sent to the local core

timeout_seconds.description: Fail-fast timeout used for Core and Relay requests

async_turns_enabled.description: Use the shared asynchronous Turn and SSE protocol; fall back only when the Core explicitly lacks the endpoint

turn_checkpoint_file.description: Persistent async Turn cursor and reducer state outside the plugin source directory

identity_salt_env.description: Environment variable containing the identity HMAC salt

identity_salt_file.description: Optional direct path to the identity HMAC salt file; used when the environment variable is absent

core_token_file_env.description: Environment variable pointing to the optional Core token file

core_token_file.description: Optional direct path to the Core shared-token file; used before the environment-variable path

route_all_private_messages.description: Route every private message to Meguri; otherwise require /meguri

allow_group_messages.description: Allow explicit /meguri commands in group chats

route_all_group_messages.description: Route every group message delivered to AstrBot to Meguri; requires allow_group_messages

bilingual_zh_ja.description: Render AstrBot replies as paired Chinese translations and Japanese originals

daily_reports_enabled.description: Poll the remote Core inbox and proactively deliver validated local daily reports

daily_report_targets.description: Exact AstrBot unified message origins receiving daily reports

daily_report_kinds.description: Report kinds polled from the Core inbox

daily_report_poll_seconds.description: Seconds between Core inbox polls; minimum 30

daily_report_max_age_hours.description: Do not proactively send reports older than this window

daily_report_state_file.description: Persistent per-target delivery state outside the plugin source directory

daily_report_render_directory.description: Persistent directory for rendered daily report images

identity_bindings.description: Explicit platform identities bound to stable Meguri users

account_id.description: Bot account ID or * for every account

remote_commands_enabled.description: Enable remote development commands through Meguri Relay

relay_url.description: Meguri Relay URL; non-loopback addresses must use HTTPS

relay_token_file_env.description: Environment variable pointing to the Relay access-token file
